title: agents-inc: Cross-Vendor Governance for an Agentic-AI Workforce
description:
agents-inc runs AI models the way a company runs staff: a Lead takes your request, delegates it down an org chart of cheaper Worker models, and accepts nothing until a reviewer signs off. It is a Python package that hands work from one AI coding session to other models and checks the result before anyone accepts it. It supports Claude, Codex, Gemini, Mistral and OpenRouter capacity, so you can delegate as you please across subscriptions. A four-rung ladder (Executive, Orchestrator, Workhorse, Grunt) sets the model management. A model never grades its own work: each result passes deterministic checks, then a reviewer, and the decision goes into an append-only ledger. The main entry point is the agents-inc command (dispatch, doctor, repair, ledger). Install with pip install agents-inc, then run agents-inc install; the import name is agents_inc. The project is experimental, and no measurements of efficacy have been benchmarked yet.

This release (0.6.4)

0.6.4 fixes dispatch warnings and error messages, and adds guest agents for other providers; it also carries the 0.6.3 changes. This record covers 0.6.3 and 0.6.4 because 0.6.3 has no Zenodo record.

Added

  • Guest agents for Gemini, Mistral and OpenRouter free models, and for Codex models, appear as native Agent types. Each non-Claude provider needs a per-workspace authorization first.
  • Role settings: agents-inc install and repair take --role KEY=VALUE to override the role defaults.
  • The agents pane names each guest agent's provider.
  • agents-inc narrate (prototype) speaks a short digest of each new Claude Code assistant message with macOS say.
  • Luna hand-backs that skip tools, stop early or report values no tool produced get one push.

Changed

  • LICENSE is now the official PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0 text, unmodified. The no-AI-training terms moved to LICENSE-AI.md and the required notices to NOTICE; both still apply (#157).
  • The 0.6.3 description called that release license-only. It also shipped the changes listed here; this description corrects that.

Fixed

  • Dispatch warns when a Codex delegate is pointed at a path outside the dispatch directory, which it cannot read (#167, #112, #155)
  • The update hint also names pipx upgrade agents-inc and uv tool upgrade agents-inc (#155)
  • The mod install failed warning includes the last line of the Claude CLI error (#155)
  • The failure-gate lint message says a gate line needs a backticked command; QUICKREF lists the classification values and the BASH_ALLOW rule (#155)
  • Dispatch runs go to .scratch/agents-inc-runs when git ignores .scratch, so the agents pane lists Codex delegates (#154)
  • The default FAN_OUT follows the --model rung, and the ceiling error names the ceiling and the fix (#156)
  • The credential screen no longer refuses a slot that names the user's .claude/AGENTS.md; every credential location stays refused (#146)
  • AT_ROUTE_CODEX_READ=1 lets @@ Codex aliases read files in the project directory (#148)
  • Codex tool commands find Homebrew python3 first, because the system stub failed under the sandbox.

Roadmap at 0.6.4

  • Now: measure the token cost of delegation against doing the work in one session, and port the test suite to Windows (#138).
  • Next: let a Worker launched by a broker lead its own Workers (#73).
  • Later: route work by data classification (#19).

Cite as: DO Mattioli (2026). agents-inc: Cross-Vendor Governance for an Agentic-AI Workforce. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22670100
